newsitem.title: USA: Musicland names Benson vice chairman, CFO.
newsitem.headline: Musicland names Benson vice chairman, CFO.

text.p: Musicland Stores Corp said Monday Keith Benson has been named vice chairman and chief financial officer, replacing Reid Johnson.
Johnson resigned to pursue another corporate opportunity on the East Coast and to fulfill some long-standing personal goals, the company said.
Benson had been president of the company's mall division, restructuring the division by closing underperforming stores, streamlining management and strengthening sales and marketing strategies.
He will lead the company's overall strategic planning efforts, as well as its financial, systems, legal and human resources activities, the company said.
Musicland shares were down 1/16 at 3-5/8 Monday.
